units.brigade-grokbot-inbox-watch.service:
# Generated by Brigade Grok Bot inbox watch installation.
[Unit]
Description=Watch the Grok Bot inbox inbox and route
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/srv/example/checkout/src/brigade
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I -c "import importlib.util as u,os,pathlib as p,runpy as r,sys as s;i,m=s.argv.pop(1),s.argv.pop(1);f=p.Path(i).is_file() and u.spec_from_file_location(m.partition('.')[0],i);f and f.loader or (s.stderr.write('brigade:cannot-load:'+i+'\\n'),s.exit(78));d=p.Path(f.origin).resolve().parent;os.chdir(d);s.path.append(str(d.parent));q=u.module_from_spec(f);s.modules[f.name]=q;f.loader.exec_module(q);r.run_module(m,run_name='__main__',alter_sys=True)" /srv/example/checkout/src/brigade/__init__.py brigade.dot watch --target /srv/example --pack grokbot-inbox
TimeoutStartSec=180
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077
PrivateTmp=no
units.brigade-grokbot-inbox-watch.timer:
# Generated by Brigade Grok Bot inbox watch installation.
[Unit]
Description=Watch Grok Bot inbox every five minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=5min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s
Unit=brigade-grokbot-inbox-watch.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
